increment_status: Capability-based terminal presentation/source integration implemented; final focused Linux Debug/strict/PTY/JIT/O2/linked-AOT acceptance passed. Native Windows/macOS and final Stage10/Wrench acceptance pending.
implemented: Immutable per-endpoint capabilities; public size/cursor_position/set_cursor/set_cursor_visible/set_color/reset_color/clear/set_title/bell with existing result/io_error conventions and all 16 palette values.

POSIX actual ioctl dimensions and system terminfo strings/parameter expansion/padding. No PTY/ANSI-name guess; redirected/dumb/unknown controls emit no bytes, independently classified endpoints and access directions.

Owned input-before-output cursor transaction, same InputReader/queue, pre-request bytes excluded, only recognized fresh report erased. Monotonic 200ms deadline, no hidden channels/mode changes; stale/CRLF/unrelated/invalid bytes and errors preserved.
Existing native output gate, NativeSafe roots, checked owned control bytes, exact native/cleanup/partial UTF16 progress, concurrent records and entered best-effort cancellation retained.
Windows native live buffer geometry/cursor/visibility, native 16-color/default attributes, visible clear/home, UTF16 title and processed-output bell implemented; no native verification claimed.
Ordinary source wrappers/metadata and independent IR checks, private ABI vd_console_v2 for enlarged reply, console-v2/terminal-v1 compatibility, exact JIT/AOT/archive/install/cache paths.

System facility DSO lifetime matches normal dynamic linkage; per-call descriptors free and prior host cur_term restores. CMake/production Linux build supplies libdl. Step28 stale current matrix references repaired.

unresolved_observations: One early current-revision publication assertion failed without further diagnostics. It did not reproduce with explicit contract checks or a minimal variant without them. A later final-source default-root run failed operator_reload and temporal_ir with _year/year library diagnostics; original library bytes subsequently matched the baseline, and isolated, explicit-original-root and default-root reruns passed. External interference is a hypothesis, not a proven cause. Final acceptance uses the exact baseline library in a verified isolated root. No check was disabled; these earlier observations remain unexplained and retained for independent review.
unverified: Native Windows SDK compilation and actual traditional console/Windows Terminal/ConPTY behavior, independent buffers/stdio associations, permissions, native error/partial operation, original attributes/title and mode/code-page preservation.
Native macOS SDK/system ncurses legacy tparm bindings/tty behavior; no local target toolchain/run available.
Fresh Release, new console editor cross-product, actual emulator visual policy and consolidated final Stage10 acceptance.

supported_policy.POSIX: Live dimensions even without terminfo; controls only from advertised terminfo facilities. Cursor DSR only when exact declared query/report grammar and matching accessible host noncanonical/no-echo stdin exist, under exclusive queue ownership.
supported_policy.Windows: Native console output APIs, native no-input-read cursor information under conservative stdin ownership; redirected controls unsupported; raw UTF8/wide-console boundaries unchanged.
supported_policy.ownership: Host must coordinate foreign readers/descriptor changes; shared VOID leases protect its readers. Already-entered uncancellable borrowed syscalls keep approved best-effort lifetime qualification.
supported_policy.progress: Presentation errors count emitted control/request bytes; unrelated input never consumed. Direct Win32 presentation has no source-byte payload and may partially affect the display before a native error. Windows half-scalar fields remain intact.

ABI_build_scope: Existing catalog/console_native IR path extended; private reply gains two i64 fields, versioned vd_console_v2 avoids old-object buffer mismatch. No new backend, GC, reader registry, scheduler or terminal session system.

new.abi: system terminfo (Linux soname 6; Darwin system ncurses fallback)
new.license: MIT/X11 (system ncurses package); no library or database redistribution
new.residency: Process-owned native facility, like ordinary dynamic linkage; per-call TERMINAL instances freed, previous cur_term restored. No global curses cleanup or module unload.

pinned_unchanged.licenses: Unchanged: Ryu Boost 1.0 option, Howard Hinnant date v3.0.3 MIT notices, IANA 2026e public domain; LLVM/Clang 19.1.7 pinned.

dependencies.packaging: No terminfo implementation/database redistribution. Optional system DSO is process native state; text/OS dimensions still function without it. CMake CMAKE_DL_LIBS and production Linux -ldl handle loader symbols. Native executable smoke verifies build packaging.
